acip: KHA CIG NA RE, DNGOS PO'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA MA YIN PA'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA'I GZHI MTHUN YOD ZER NA,
wylie: kha cig na re, dngos po'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ma yin pa'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun yod zer na
english: And suppose someone comes and makes this claim: There does exist one thing which is both a quality of which something is characteristic, and something characteristic of that quality, which is at the same time neither a quality of which working things are characteristic, nor characteristic of the quality of working things.
